title: TEXT DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local transaction evidence for DRW_Text::encodeDwg; no physical producer or output-support claim.

implementation.behavior: The encoder stages body, string and handle streams, preserves aliases, and publishes all streams only after successful encoding. A scoped rollback guard restores the original oType on every failure and retains oType=1 on success.
implementation.profile: Generated TEXT with Unicode text, non-default alignment, common owner/reactor/extension handles, and seeded caller buffers.

allocationSweep.mechanism: One-shot global allocation failure countdown in the generated object-vector test
allocationSweep.result: 24 reached allocation-failure offsets per version returned false without throwing, preserved seeded body/string/handle bytes, bit counts, handle occurrences and original oType, and succeeded on same-object retry with bytes equal to clean output and oType=1.
allocationSweep.aliasControl: Failure at the first reached allocation preserved the all-streams-aliased destination and original oType; same-object retry matched the clean aliased encoding.
